red-f88e-downgrade-non-regression.mjs pins 4 sub-cases against the same compiled fix: (1) a lone superseded verdict with no live identity-equal counterpart is still downgraded onto current material with its mandatory re-attestation advisory and preserved originalMaterialDigest provenance; (2) two genuinely native same-identity verdicts recorded at the CURRENT material still trigger duplicate host/session/key identity invalidation (the fix must not over-broadly suppress real double-vote detection); (3) two EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH values (sha256 of empty string) are treated as no-signal, never authorising a downgrade; (4) a case-variant hostId (Claude-CLI vs claude-cli) is still caught via normalizeIdentity (trim+lowercase, the same function host-independence.ts groupByIndependentHost uses), preventing a trim-only-copy bug. Ran independently in this review against the built dist: exit=0, all 4 assertions pass.
